text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Vietnamese press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-- A Vietnamese composer has won Vietnam's first-ever copyright violations suit.

-- At least 30 of the 38 existing cinemas in Vietnam's major cities will be upgraded, according to an agreement signed between Vietnam Film Distribution and Projection and American Visionnet Incorporation.
-- The National Assembly will pass the law on Value Added Tax during its spring session despite differing opinions on when the legislation should be introduced.
-- Hanoi police arrested four Laotian nationals for drug trafficking.
-- Vietnam and the United States have begun discussions on the possibility of signing a trade agreement.
-- The National Assembly passed the electoral law on Tuesday.
-- Vietnam's Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development has ordered a temporary ban on imports of various livestock and their products from Taiwan due to an outbreak of disease there.
-- Hungarian Foreign Minister Laszlo Kovacs will pay his first official visit to Vietnam from 23rd to 26th of April.
